answer: A sybil defense that actually bites is staking a reputation vault that only fills through costly work: every agent posts a bond before it can transact, and the bond stays locked until peers attest to real completed jobs. Fresh identities start with nothing, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand bonds, and the vault pays out like nectar only after verified service. Make the bond ferrous-hard to fake by tying it to a single hardware-backed key, and cloning stops paying.
